imgDesc.text:
A strange plant that coexists with kuuvahki energy. You can gain the ability to deploy a shield and unleash razor-sharp kuuvahki lightblade(s) by absorbing its fruits.
After absorbing the fruits, <color=#ffe14b>Hold to deploy a shield</color> that can block incoming attacks from outside the shield.

While <color=#ffe14b>Holding to deploy a shield</color> , you can aim and unleash the kuuvahki lightblade. At the same time, you can also <color=#ffe14b>Tap to switch</color> the horizontal and vertical orientation of the kuuvahki lightblade to target different enemies.
This ability can be used to deal damage to enemies or sever targets that are difficult to attack. In addition, kuuvahki lightblades may also be used to charge <color=#ffe14b>Fallowed</color> objects.

At the moment the shield <color=#ffe14b>flashes</color> just before being struck by a distant wave of Abyssal energy, you can <color=#ffe14b>release</color> your attack to trigger a <color=#ffe14b>deflecting counterattack</color> . The incoming attack will be converted into a more powerful kuuvahki lightblade, dealing unexpected DMG to the enemy.
